author: Kati Pas
title: Looking for grounded character art
content: Doing research into character art for my story. Very talented people on here, but its mostly fantasy/romantacy vibes. I need something a bit more grounded. Author follow-up: Like something that looks like it would be based in the real world. Im writing an organized crime story. UPDATE: Due to a big hospital bill I might have to pay soon, my price range for character art has lowered. About $50 - $75 dollars each for 4 characters. Later: Thank you to all the responses. I'm seeing a lot of amazing artists and Im still catching up. Im sorry if I haven't responded to yours yet. Contact: reply on the Threads post.
